recent_actions.Risk: Increased militarization of Taiwan, potential for escalation with China.

recent_actions.Risk: Increased military spending, arms race, potential for use in future conflicts.

recent_actions.Risk: Continued ISIS threat, regional instability, reliance on intelligence support.

recent_actions.Risk: Arms race, increased military spending, technological competition.

recent_actions.Action: Signed memorandum to jointly acquire four Airbus A330 MRTT tanker aircraft.
recent_actions.Risk: Increased military spending, regional arms buildup, European defense integration.

recent_actions.Action: European allies largely filled gaps left by US reductions in NATO Force Model.
recent_actions.Risk: Weakening of NATO cohesion, increased burden on European allies, potential for US disengagement.

recent_actions.Risk: High-risk space mission, potential for orbital debris, space infrastructure vulnerability.

recent_actions.Risk: Space exploration risks, cost overruns, international competition in lunar exploration.

recent_actions.Risk: Space station safety, gap in human spaceflight capability, international cooperation challenges.
